attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has approved an investment in a 1,800 MW Pumped Storage Project at Shirwata, Maharashtra. The total investment required is Rs. 11,871 crore. Financing will be structured with 75% debt and 25% equity. The proposed capacity addition is expected to be completed within 51 months. The company's existing capacity is 16.9 GW, currently at optimum utilization levels. The project aims to support Renewable Energy Round the Clock applications, facilitate energy shifting, and contribute to decarbonizing hard-to-abate industries. This disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is available on the company website at www.tatapower.com.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release issued by the Company on the Audited Standalone Financial Results and Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Tata Power reported its highest-ever quarterly Profit After Tax of 1,652 crore for Q2 FY27, up 33 percent year-on-year. Half-year PAT reached 3,053 crore, up 22 percent. Revenue grew 26 percent to 19,886 crore in the quarter and 17 percent to 38,784 crore in the half-year. EBITDA increased 5 percent to 4,245 crore in Q2 and 7 percent to 8,494 crore in H1. attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board meeting of Tata Steel Limited for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited approved its audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion due to non-recognition of further fair value reduction for Tata Steel Nederland B.V., which has a carrying value of Rs. 59,078.13 crore. The auditor also highlighted an emphasis of matter regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with Rujuvalika Investments Limited, approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on October 1, 2026. Mr. Noel Naval Tata, DIN 00024713, will retire as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice Chairman effective November 11, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 7, 2026.

attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Tata Steel submitted a press release and investor presentation to BSE and NSE on November 7, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 10,665 crores for the quarter and Rs 20,035 crores for the half year. Consolidated revenues were Rs 65,436 crores for the quarter and Rs 1,26,231 crores for the half year. India revenues were Rs 42,653 crores for the quarter. Netherlands revenues were €1,395 million. UK revenues were £411 million with an EBITDA loss of £56 million. Capital expenditure was Rs 3,280 crores for the quarter and Rs 6,860 crores for the half year. Net debt stood at Rs 91,423 crores with a net debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.4x. Group liquidity was Rs 40,076 crores.
